parameters.query:
SELECT
  e.id AS employee_id,
  e.full_name,
  e.email,
  d.name AS department,
  json_agg(json_build_object(
    'product_name',     p.product_name,
    'quantity',         p.quantity,
    'price',            p.price,
    'discount_percent', x.discount_percent,
    'new_price',        ROUND(p.price * (100 - x.discount_percent) / 100, 2),
    'expiry_date',      to_char(p.expiry_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
    'days_left',        p.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE
  ) ORDER BY p.expiry_date, p.product_name) AS items
FROM employees e
JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id
JOIN products p    ON p.department_id = e.department_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  -- same discount rule as expiry-check.json
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p.expiry_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 0
    WHEN p.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 1 THEN 30
    WHEN p.expiry_date - CURRENT_DATE <= 3 THEN 20
    ELSE 0 END AS discount_percent
) x
WHERE e.role = 'employee'
  AND e.is_active = TRUE
  AND p.quantity > 0
  AND p.expiry_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 3
GROUP BY e.id, e.full_name, e.email, d.name
ORDER BY d.name, e.full_name;
